entries.en: Hello there. Welcome to Morlan's famous shop. You want many good supplies, yes?
entries.tr: Merhaba. Morlan'ın ünlü dükkânına hoş geldiniz. Çok iyi malzeme istiyorsunuz, evet?

entries.en: But I was told the doctor would be bringing them.
entries.tr: Ama bana malzemeleri doktorun getireceği söylenmişti.

entries.en: There's been a change of plans.
A change? But... the doctor... I don't.... This is not right, human.
entries.tr: Değişiklik mi? Ama... doktor... ben... Bu doğru değil, insan.

entries.en: What the hell's going on here? Who are you?
We can end this if you just bring me those supplies. Otherwise, I'll start telling people about the doctor's little secret.
entries.tr: Şu malzemeleri bana getirirsen bunu bitirebiliriz. Yoksa insanlara doktorun küçük sırrını anlatmaya başlarım.

entries.en: Hey, hold on! I'm just the middleman here.
This is way more than I bargained for.
entries.tr: Bu, tahmin ettiğimden çok daha fazla.

entries.en: Thank you, human. It is good to see him humbled so.
entries.tr: Teşekkürler, insan. Onun böyle alçaltıldığını görmek güzel.

entries.en: I won't go down without a fight!
You were expecting a delivery of medical supplies.
Leave the doctor alone.
Leave the doctor alone. Or you'll have to deal with me.
entries.tr: Doktoru rahat bırak. Yoksa benimle uğraşırsın.

entries.en: You're shutting down a medical clinic. What if someone needs treatment? What if you need treatment?
entries.tr: Bir sağlık kliniğini kapatıyorsun. Biri tedaviye ihtiyaç duyarsa ne olacak? Ya sen tedaviye ihtiyaç duyarsan?

entries.en: Her secret stays buried. Or I bury you.
entries.tr: Onun sırrı gömülü kalır. Yoksa seni gömerim.

entries.en: That secret dies with you!
I'm here about Dr. Michel.
A friend of Dr. Michel.
This is over.
You should reconsider.
Talk and you're dead!
Kill him.
Oh, you will be pleased, I think. Very good things I have, you will see.
entries.tr: Ah, hoşunuza gidecek, sanırım. Çok güzel şeylerim var, göreceksiniz.

entries.en: Let me see what you have.
I need supplies.
Yes, all right then. Good tidings to you, human.
entries.tr: Evet, pekâlâ o zaman. İyi dileklerimle, insan.

entries.en: Goodbye.
I should go.
Goodbye.
I have never met him, human. I only worked with the one who spoke with the doctor.
entries.tr: Onunla hiç tanışmadım, insan. Ben sadece doktorla konuşanla çalıştım.

entries.en: What do you know about Banes?
Who's Banes?
Change of plans.
Things have changed, Morlan.
Change of plans.
Change of plans.
Yes, human? You need something, yes?
entries.tr: Evet, insan? Bir şeye ihtiyacın var, evet?

entries.en: Shut up, Morlan. I told Banes you'd screw this up!
entries.tr: Kapa çeneni, Morlan. Banes'e bunu berbat edeceğini söylemiştim!

entries.en: Only if you're willing to die happy.
Then we do this the hard way!
entries.tr: O zaman bunu zor yoldan yaparız!

entries.en: Maybe we can find a way to make both sides happy here.
entries.tr: Belki burada iki tarafı da memnun edecek bir yol bulabiliriz.

entries.en: You're not getting anything from the doctor.
Your worst nightmare.
Let's work this out.
No deal.
Well, that will certainly change things around here.
entries.tr: Şey, bu buradaki işleri kesinlikle değiştirecek.

entries.en: For the better. He was a brute. A bully.
entries.tr: İyi yönde. O bir vahşiydi. Bir zorbaydı.

entries.en: [View Items]
[View Armors]
[View Standard Items]
[View Non-human Armors]
Hold it right there.
Just throw me the data and you can walk away.
I didn't come out to play games with you, human.
You know who I am, and I know you're stalling.
entries.tr: Kim olduğumu biliyorsun, ben de oyalandığını biliyorum.

entries.en: I don't think so, human.
I'll ask you one more time. Give me the data and you and Jahleed will live to see another day.
entries.tr: Sana bir kez daha soracağım. Verileri bana ver, sen ve Jahleed bir gün daha yaşayın.

entries.en: Fine, have it your way.
Wait! I give up. I give up! Please... don't kill me.
entries.tr: Dur! Pes ediyorum. Pes ediyorum! Lütfen... beni öldürme.

entries.en: No! Look, Jahleed can have the data. I don't want it. Not if it means I'm going to die.
entries.tr: Hayır! Bak, Jahleed verileri alabilir. Ben istemiyorum. Ölmem anlamına geliyorsa istemiyorum.

entries.en: What is this data? Why is it so important?
entries.tr: Bu veriler ne? Neden bu kadar önemli?

entries.en: I thought you knew. He said you were going to deliver it.
The keepers are almost impossible to scan, and you can't capture them or get samples. They just self-destruct.
entries.tr: Keeper'ları taramak neredeyse imkânsız, onları yakalayamazsın veya numune alamazsın. Kendilerini imha ediyorlar.

entries.en: After centuries here, we still don't know anything about them.
entries.tr: Yüzyıllardır burada olmamıza rağmen onlar hakkında hâlâ hiçbir şey bilmiyoruz.

entries.en: We lost our heads. We just couldn't let an opportunity like this pass us by.
entries.tr: Aklımızı kaybettik. Böyle bir fırsatı kaçırmak istemedik.

entries.en: But it doesn't matter now. I just want to live. I don't care if I ever see that data again.
entries.tr: Ama artık önemi yok. Sadece yaşamak istiyorum. O veriyi bir daha görsem umurumda değil.

entries.en: I won't-- or I will. Stick to research, that is. Thank you. Goodbye.
entries.tr: Yapmayacağım-- ya da yapacağım. Araştırmaya bağlı kalacağım yani. Teşekkürler. Hoşça kal.

entries.en: I will-- I mean, I won't see you again.
entries.tr: Yapacağım-- yani seni bir daha görmeyeceğim.

entries.en: So, what do you want to do about Jahleed?
entries.tr: Peki, Jahleed ile ne yapmak istiyorsun?

entries.en: What? No! Please!
What data? What are you talking about?
If you see me again, it'll be the last thing you see.
entries.tr: Beni bir daha görürsen göreceğin son şey olur.

entries.en: Let's go have a talk with our chubby friend.
I'm gonna show him what happens to people who lie to me!
entries.tr: Bana yalan söyleyenlere ne olduğunu ona göstereceğim!

entries.en: I'll speak with him later.
Don't worry, you won't. Nobody attacks me and walks away.
entries.tr: Merak etme, görmeyeceksin. Kimse bana saldırıp yanına kâr kalamaz.

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want?
Drop your weapons. Now!
We don't have what you're looking for.
There's no need to let things get out of hand.
Come and get it, salarian. It'll be the last mistake you make.
entries.tr: Gel de al salarian. Yapacağın son hata olur.

entries.en: Why shouldn't I kill you right here? Why are you willing to die for this data?
entries.tr: Seni burada neden öldürmeyeyim? Bu veri için neden ölmeye hazırsın?

entries.en: What's so important about this data? Why are you trying to get it?
entries.tr: Bu veri neden bu kadar önemli? Neden onu almaya çalışıyorsun?

entries.en: Sorry, I can't put my gun away until the job is done.
So you're just trying to get back what Jahleed already stole.
entries.tr: Yani Jahleed'in çaldığını geri almaya çalışıyorsun.

entries.en: I should kill both of you idiots.
I suggest you stick to research and leave the espionage to the rest of us.
entries.tr: Araştırmaya bağlı kalmanızı ve casusluğu bizlere bırakmanızı öneririm.

entries.en: Data?
Who are you?
Back down.
There is no data.
Let's talk about this.
Over my dead body.
Why not?
Convince me.
Too bad.
What?
I see.
(sigh)
Good. Go.
Get out of here.
You're not leaving.
Time for a chat.
I'm gonna kill him.
Leave him for now.
So why is this data so valuable?
entries.tr: Peki bu veri neden bu kadar değerli?

entries.en: Why is this data so valuable?
entries.tr: Bu veri neden bu kadar değerli?

entries.en: What's so important about this data?
entries.tr: Bu veri neden bu kadar önemli?

entries.en: What makes the data so valuable?
entries.tr: Veriyi bu kadar değerli kılan ne?

entries.en: What about Jahleed?
What do we do about the lying volus?
What should we do about Jahleed?
What about the volus? What should we do with him?
entries.tr: Volus ne olacak? Onunla ne yapmalıyız?

entries.en: Boys.
It's the initial data. From scanning the keepers.
You see. We stole some research from our work, to make the scanners.
entries.tr: Görüyorsun. Tarayıcıları yapmak için çalışmamızdan bazı araştırmaları çaldık.

entries.en: We were supposed to work together. I get the data, he analyzes it.
entries.tr: Birlikte çalışacaktık. Ben veriyi alırım, o analiz eder.

entries.en: Commander. I wasn't expecting to see you again. Is there something you want?
entries.tr: Komutan. Sizi tekrar görmeyi beklemiyordum. Bir şey mi istiyorsunuz?

entries.en: I'm not sure what you're referring to. My experiments are...
We're not buying it. Jahleed told us you've been after him.
entries.tr: Buna inanmıyoruz. Jahleed bize onun peşinde olduğunu söyledi.

entries.en: Quit stalling. Your friend Jahleed told us about you.
entries.tr: Oyalamayı bırak. Arkadaşın Jahleed bize senden bahsetti.

entries.en: Your lies are catching up with you. We spoke with your friend, Jahleed.
entries.tr: Yalanların peşini bırakmıyor. Arkadaşın Jahleed'le konuştuk.

entries.en: Quit stalling. Jahleed told us what you've been up to.
entries.tr: Oyalamayı bırak. Jahleed bize ne yaptığını anlattı.

entries.en: Quit stalling. Jahleed told us you've been after him.
entries.tr: Oyalamayı bırak. Jahleed bize onun peşinde olduğunu söyledi.

entries.en: You... spoke with Jahleed? Then you know about the data?
entries.tr: Siz... Jahleed'le mi konuştunuz? O halde veriyi biliyorsunuz?

entries.en: You boys can go.
Looks like my plans have changed.
It's not as bad as you think, Commander. Jahleed and I just got a little... over our heads.
entries.tr: Düşündüğünüz kadar kötü değil Komutan. Jahleed ve ben biraz... altından kalkamayacağımız işe girdik.

entries.en: The company we work for developed an experimental procedure for use in medical scanners.
entries.tr: Çalıştığımız şirket tıbbi tarayıcılarda kullanmak için deneysel bir prosedür geliştirdi.

entries.en: Jahleed and I saw even more potential. So we stole the plans and secretly developed a tool to scan the keepers.
entries.tr: Jahleed ve ben daha da fazla potansiyel gördük. Planları çalıp gizlice bekçileri tarayacak bir alet geliştirdik.

entries.en: Can you imagine? A tool that can actually get readings from the keepers?
entries.tr: Hayal edebiliyor musunuz? Bekçilerden gerçekten okuma alabilen bir alet?

entries.en: Don't you see? We were the first to scan them. Ever!
entries.tr: Görmüyor musunuz? Onları ilk tarayan biziz. Hiç kimse daha önce yapmadı!

entries.en: You've seen it yourself, Commander. You know we can do it.
I'm not trying to kill him.
Jahleed's job was to disseminate our initial findings.
But... he decided to keep the data for himself. Maybe to sell it. I don't know.
entries.tr: Ama... veriyi kendine saklamaya karar verdi. Belki satmak için. Bilmiyorum.

entries.en: Commander. If you'll just continue gathering data for me... imagine what we might learn.
entries.tr: Komutan. Benim için veri toplamaya devam ederseniz... neler öğrenebileceğimizi hayal edin.

entries.en: And you'll stand to make a bit of profit yourself, remember.
entries.tr: Ve unutmayın, siz de biraz kâr edeceksiniz.

entries.en: All right. You don't need to ask twice.
entries.tr: Pekâlâ. İki kez sormanıza gerek yok.

entries.en: Well then, no more scanning. I promise.
entries.tr: Peki o zaman, artık tarama yok. Söz veriyorum.

entries.en: Of course, Jahleed still has the initial data and I doubt he's planning to return it.
entries.tr: Elbette Jahleed hâlâ ilk veriye sahip ve geri vermeyi planladığından şüpheliyim.

entries.en: Very good. Maybe if you wouldn't mind speaking with Jahleed.
entries.tr: Çok iyi. Belki Jahleed'le konuşmanızın sakıncası olmaz.

entries.en: The data you're gathering for me is useless if Jahleed won't help me analyze it.
entries.tr: Jahleed analiz etmeme yardım etmezse benim için topladığınız veri işe yaramaz.

entries.en: Thank you, and happy scanning, Commander.
It's not difficult, really.
Just get within range and scan them.
You seem interested. Enough to help me perhaps?
entries.tr: İlgili görünüyorsunuz. Belki bana yardım edecek kadar?

entries.en: I'll give you my scanner.
Whenever you see a keeper, scan it. Discretely.
My database will update automatically each time you scan a unique keeper. Then I'll update your account with a few credits.
entries.tr: Veri tabanım benzersiz bir bekçiyi her taradığınızda otomatik güncellenecek. Sonra hesabınıza birkaç kredi yatıracağım.

entries.en: And what exactly was I supposed to be delivering?
entries.tr: Ve tam olarak ne teslim etmem gerekiyordu?

entries.en: You can start by telling me the truth, Chorban.
Drop the act. I want to know what's going on, Chorban.
entries.tr: Rolü bırak. Neler olduğunu bilmek istiyorum Chorban.

entries.en: Just tell me everything you know.
No. But you're going to tell me. Everything.
entries.tr: Hayır. Ama bana anlatacaksın. Her şeyi.

entries.en: Keep talking.
That's what all the fuss is about?
What's so special about that?
Why are you trying to kill your partner?
That doesn't explain why you're trying to kill your partner.
I'm not breaking regulations for you or your research. Return what you stole, or I'll have you arrested.
entries.tr: Senin ya da araştırman için yönetmelikleri çiğnemeyeceğim. Çaldığını geri ver yoksa seni tutuklatırım.

entries.en: I'll deal with Jahleed.
If it'll help further the scientific cause, how can I refuse?
entries.tr: Bilimsel davaya yardımı olacaksa nasıl reddedebilirim?

entries.en: I suppose a little scanning here and there won't hurt anyone.
entries.tr: Sanırım şurada burada biraz tarama kimseye zarar vermez.

entries.en: If I have time, I'll talk to him.
I'll go have a chat with right now.
entries.tr: Gidip şimdi onunla bir sohbet edeceğim.

entries.en: So how do you gather data on the keepers?
How could I help you?
Did he know?
He said that?
I'm not sure I follow.
The truth.
No more lies.
I want answers.
Not yet.
Enough!
Data?
How so?
Go on.
That's it?
So?
I'm not sure I follow.
And Jahleed?
There's more to this.
No more.
Sure.
All right.
Don't worry.
Get moving.
He won't get away.
Maybe.
Of course.
Sure.
Scanning?
Maybe.
No thanks.
So long, Commander.
I don't think so.
Hold it. That's close enough, army.
entries.tr: Dur orada. Bu kadar yaklaşman yeter asker.

entries.en: You got my payment?
Show him the merchandise.
That looks about right.
Damn straight it is! These mods are the best on the market. Now hand over my credits.
entries.tr: Kesinlikle! Bu modifikasyonlar piyasadaki en iyi olanlar. Şimdi kredilerimi ver.

entries.en: Here you go. Enjoy it.
It's a sting. Bastard set us up.
entries.tr: Bu bir tuzak. Piç bizi tuzağa düşürdü.

entries.en: What the hell are you playing at?
Sense of humor, huh? It's gonna get you killed one of these days, army.
entries.tr: Mizah anlayışı var, ha? Bir gün bu seni öldürecek asker.

entries.en: Come on, boys. We're done here.
Stupid-ass army boy. Kill him!
Stupid army bitch. Kill her!
Show her the goods.
Do you have the mods?
I didn't come here to look.
Here you go.
I'll just take the weapons.
I'm taking you in, Jax.
Here's your money, Jax.
Sorry, Jax. This is the end for you.
Maybe.
Of course.
Yeah.
Sure.
I don't think so.
You're under arrest.
Just kidding.
You heard me!
Hm. Nobody died.
I could shoot someone if it'd make you feel better.
Nah. I'm good.
Looks good.
That looks about right.
That looks right.
Yeah, that looks right.
